rules: GA retains all original vertices, including DISCARD vertices; only DISCARD receives new rip=1
outside vertices first in original index order, then each defect's original ordered vertices
restore TMP and compute metric properties before copied current positions/normals
copy five vectors and fifteen scalar fields explicitly; original coordinates remain smoothed original
filter all marked-vertex faces in source face order
filter original incident face/corner rows and original one-ring rows independently
retain outside-outside neighbor entries even if no surviving incident face
inside topology stays zero; outside nsizeCur/Max=1 and vtotal=vnum
do not copy original rip, marks, border, vertex area, tangent vectors or flattened positions
new vertex and topology storage is zeroed before logical growth
new face, face-normal cache and deferred-normal storage is zeroed
surface global nsize and max_nsize initialize to 1
base capacity is original N+10 and 2F; only logical arrays are outputs
VOL_GEOM assignment copies ras_good_flag and three shear fields with dimensions/spacing/direction/center
fname and two existing transforms are copied
register_mat is not assigned; destination fresh null remains null
AffineMatrix has 16 float values in native storage order; observer reads without calling transform computation

benchmark_boundary: declared complete before-state fields to independently constructed initial GA base
